content.title: Chapter 58 - MUNICIPAL COURT — Sec. 58-11. - Reserved.
content.summary:
Editor's note—
Ord. No. 4830
, § 2, adopted December 5, 2022, repealed § 58-11, which pertained to record of proceedings
               and derived from § 18-15 of the 1981 Code; Ord. No. 1477, § 1, 6-19-1978; Ord. No.
               2460, § 1, 11-9-1987.
